snippet.title: Onimusha: Blade Warriors (2004) - PS2 Longplay | Full Game Walkthrough | No Commentary
snippet.description:
Onimusha: Blade Warriors is a 3D fighting game based on Capcom's Onimusha series, released for the PlayStation 2 in 2004. This full game longplay features characters from the Onimusha universe battling across interactive stages filled with weapons, items, and Genma enemies.

Developed by Capcom Production Studio 2, Onimusha: Blade Warriors combines traditional fighting mechanics with elements of the Onimusha series. Players can choose from a variety of characters, each with unique attacks and abilities, while using weapons and items found throughout the stages.

This full walkthrough covers the complete game from start to finish with no commentary, showcasing the playable characters, battles, stages, special attacks, and classic Onimusha fighting gameplay.

🎮 Game: Onimusha: Blade Warriors
📅 Release Year: 2004
